completion_bound.note: Optimistic completion bound for label pruning only. Legacy beta/end-time terms are ignored because makespan is a report metric, not an official pricing objective term.

final_judge.note: Opt-in final judge used exact-safe resource-labeling pricing. Certificates are allowed only for exact elementary full-subset coverage with true-dual reduced-cost audit.
final_judge.certificate_boundary: exact elementary full-subset coverage can certify no-negative

elementary_coverage_ledger.search_region_count_semantics: pricing search coverage regions; not necessarily returned columns
elementary_coverage_ledger.true_dual_audit_scope: all columns returned by pricing engine

completion_bound_certificate_support.note: Completion-bound pruning is an exact-safe optimistic tail bound and does not certify by itself.

branch_context.note: Exact branch feasibility context; guidance may rank candidates but cannot change these decisions.

cut_context.note: Exact cut coefficient context. Current runner records no active cuts by default.

objective_breakdown.note: Official objective is normalized additive operating cost, risk, and weighted completion. Makespan is reported as an evaluation metric only.
